data.name: Virtual Risk Prevention
data.detailed_description:
Virtual Risk Prevention is the ultimate Virtual Reality (VR) Occupational Risk Prevention (ORP) platform. Designed to transform theoretical training into practical experience, this application centralizes access to high-risk situations in a controlled, safe, and realistic environment.

Forget about static manuals. Here, mistakes are the best teachers, but without real consequences.

Our Occupational Risk Prevention (ORP) library includes scenarios with realistic physics and industry standard protocols:

  • Bridge Crane Operations: Load control, oscillations, and signaling in industrial warehouse environments.

  • Forklift Logistics: Load handling, reduced visibility, and traffic in active warehouses.

  • Firefighting: PASS (Pull, Aim, Squeeze, Sweep) protocols with different types of extinguishers and fires.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64bit)
  • Processor: Intel i5-4590 equivalent or greater
  • Memory: 8 GB GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 980 / AMD R9 290x equivalent or greater
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • VR Support: SteamVR compatible devices
  • Additional Notes: Requires a VR headset
